articles.title: Revealed: Iowa Republican congressman touting self-published thriller about Chinese AI attack SKIPPED hearings on real-life national security threats from Beijing
articles.summary: Iowa Congressman Zach Nunn has published a thriller exploring critical threats from Chinese AI, espionage, and the future of warfare. This move has drawn criticism, however, as Nunn reportedly missed several real-life congressional hearings on these exact national security challenges. The situation highlights the intersection of policy-making, emerging threats, and legislative duty, a relevant topic for SSB aspirants.

articles.title: Mortal remains of two soldiers, who died in Uri blast, to reach Kolhapur & Satara villages today for final farewell with full honours
articles.summary: The mortal remains of two soldiers martyred in the Uri blast are being transported to their native villages in Kolhapur and Satara for their final farewell. These brave personnel will receive full military honours, a solemn tribute to their sacrifice for the nation. This event underscores the immense personal cost of defending India's security, reminding aspirants of the ultimate commitment required in service.
